name: card-spotlight

frames.best_why: Dense violet speckle field over the whole card with all text still readable.

tagline: Violet speckles and a soft spotlight bloom on a dark card under the cursor.
summary: A rounded black information card whose surface lights up on hover. A soft radial light follows the pointer while a fine canvas of blue and purple dots spreads across the face.
appearance: A rounded near-black card with a thin grey border, holding a bold white heading, a grey paragraph and three bullet lines marked by small indigo dots. On hover a field of tiny violet and blue speckles covers the surface.
behaviour: Moving the pointer lights the card with a soft spotlight that follows it, and a fine particle field appears across the face while hovered. Leaving fades the effect back to the plain dark card.
demo_content: Heading 'Authentication Steps' with three steps: enter credentials, verify two-factor, access granted.
search_phrases: card with a spotlight that follows the mouse
particle reveal on a content card
cursor spotlight over a black panel
card with a starry hover effect
mouse tracking light on a feature tile
blue dots appear when hovering a card
use_when: A feature or information card should feel interactive when explored with the pointer.
avoid_when: The particle canvas only appears on hover, so touch users see a plain card, and it forces a black surface.
customise: Pass the card content as children and tune the spotlight radius and colour through props. The particle dot colours, size and speed are fixed in the shared effect.
weight_why: Mounts a WebGL dot-matrix canvas on hover and tears it down on leave.

a11y.note: The spotlight and particle field are hover-only, so keyboard and touch users never see them, and there is no reduced-motion guard.

issues: The canvas particle layer only appears on hover, leaving touch users with a flat card.
In the frames the spotlight is hard to separate from the speckle texture.
polish_why: Tidy card and a rich hover texture; the spotlight is hard to distinguish from the particles.
title: Card Spotlight
